title: 250 kilos of oil waste recovered after NGCP cable leak in Leyte

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) recovered 250 kilos of oil-contaminated materials from the shoreline of Barangay Tugas in Tabango, Leyte, following an oil leak involving an underwater submarine cable belonging to the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP). The Marine Environmental Protection Unit-Western Leyte continued its shoreline cleanup operations on Monday, recovering an additional 50 kilos of oil-contaminated materials using absorbent pads. According to the PCG, the latest recovery brought the cumulative volume of contaminated materials collected from the affected area near the NGCP Tabango Substation to approximately 250 kilos.
